title: Pier 51 Marina
includes: Boats come fueled up; pay for gas used
Meticulously cleaned and maintained between each rental
blurb: Pier 51 Marina offers boat rentals on Keystone Lake with a diverse fleet including pontoons and water toys. Rentals come fueled and well-maintained, with options for day and overnight rentals. The marina also provides a ship store and equipment rentals for water skiing and wakeboarding.
extraNote: Weekend and holiday rentals require a non-refundable deposit of half the rental price · Cancellations within 48 hours or due to bad weather are eligible for a refund · Boats are not permitted for nighttime operation · Pier 51 Marina office at 1926 S. Highway 151, Sand Springs, OK 74063
